title: ApprovedCuts v1
description: A human-approved edit list for one recorded video, consumed by the `apply-cuts` CLI. `cuts` are ranges to remove -- only explicitly approved CUT ranges belong here; REVIEW ranges and un-approved silences must not be included. A conservative safety margin shrinks every cut inward so a dry cut never clips a word. `asides` are ranges to keep but mark as a deliberate digression: sped up, desaturated, with a short on-screen label, then a hard cut straight back to normal; asides get no safety margin (their boundaries are an editorial choice, not a speech-safety guess) and must not overlap a cut or each other. `apply-cuts` also accepts a `cut-review.json` directly for `cuts` (it takes the segments whose suggestion is CUT); `asides` are only ever read from this shape.
